How We Farm

Simple, pasture-based practices focused on healthy animals, healthy soil, and responsible stewardship.

Regenerative Farming

We aim to improve the land as we farm it by using animals, pasture, and natural cycles to support healthier soil and stronger forage.

Frequent Pasture Rotation

Our animals are moved regularly to fresh pasture to support better forage, reduce pressure on the land, and promote healthier living conditions.

Animal Health First

We focus on prevention through clean pasture, proper nutrition, low-stress handling, and living conditions suited to each animal.

Minimal Intervention

We avoid routine antibiotics, unnecessary medications, and unnecessary interventions, relying first on sound husbandry and preventative care.

Organic Feed

When supplemental feed is needed, we use organic feed and prioritize pasture, forage, and natural food sources whenever practical.

Built Around the Land

Our farming decisions are shaped around the seasons, the pasture, and the needs of the animals rather than forcing the farm into a rigid system.
